notes.title: A Work of Art - New Horror Game Releasing October 14th!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone! We'd like to share some news!

We have a brand new game coming out October 14th called [u]A Work of Art[/u]. We've put a tremendous amount of work into this title, and we know that a lot of folks are struggling currently, so we decided to make our new game FREE so no one has to pay anything to enjoy the new experience! 💖
Players can now officially add the game to their Wishlist, as well as the Original Soundtrack found on the store page.

Players can also follow our Curator page to be notified of any new releases in the future!
All names in [u]A Work of Art[/u] were chosen by past players from previous titles, and we have multiple games releasing soon with more names chosen by players as well! 😊

It would mean the world to us if you decided to give our game a try, and we hope you have an amazing day! ♥
[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027780/A_Work_of_Art/
